analysis: {'Project A': {'Clarity of Value Proposition': '• Relatively clear – focuses on longevity, upgradeability, and reducing e-waste. The AI diagnostics are a potential differentiator if well-executed.', 'Impact and Evidence Plan': '• Weak – Claims of dust-pickup results are based on a standard protocol, but the impact of the UVC disinfection and circular service are not quantified.
